name: My Demon 'Cat'
source:
I longed for a little companion, curled close, comforting in quiet company, but what lurked in the low-lit corners was no mere cat. Crimson eyes gleamed, claws curled, and a cunning voice carried a cryptic claim—he wasn’t a cat at all

This shadowy sentinel stays steadfast, speaking secrets, stalking softly. He growls in the gloom, grumbles in the gray, guarding something greater than I can grasp.

[From [url=https://candy-curse.itch.io/my-demon-cat]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我曾渴望拥有一只小巧的伴侣，蜷缩在身侧，于静谧相伴中予我慰藉；然而潜伏在昏暗角落里的，却绝非寻常猫咪。绯红的双眸幽幽闪烁，利爪微曲，狡黠的嗓音吐露着晦涩难解的宣告——他根本就不是一只猫。

这位暗影中的守望者寸步不离，低语着隐秘，悄无声息地踱步潜行。他在幽暗中低吼，在灰霭里咕哝，默默守护着某样远超我理解范畴的存在。

[摘自[url=https://candy-curse.itch.io/my-demon-cat]itch.io[/url]]
